description: Online shop for beginner woodworking and craft kits, organized as a chronological skill journey from week one through finished projects

pages.name: home
pages.description: Storefront landing page introducing the beginner journey and surfacing starter kits along a learning timeline
components: Top bar with shop name on the left, primary nav (Kits, Path, Workshop, Journal, Help), and a right cluster with search icon, account icon, and cart icon showing item count badge

Hero block with eyebrow label 'Made for first-timers', a headline, a one-sentence subhead, a primary 'Start week 1' button and a secondary 'Browse all kits' link, plus a tool-photo placeholder on the right
Horizontal scrolling timeline rail labeled 'Your first 12 weeks' with 12 numbered stops — each stop shows week number, a tiny project thumbnail, project name, and a difficulty dot (1 to 3)
Three-card 'Most-started kits' row — each card shows project image, kit name, weekend duration, tool count, price, and a 'Add to cart' button
Footer with four columns (Shop, Learn, Support, Shipping), a 'Get the weekly project email' signup, safety-notice line, and copyright row

pages.name: path
pages.description: The full chronological learning path laid out as a vertical timeline of beginner milestones
components: Same top bar
Page header with title 'The beginner path', a paragraph explaining the 12-week progression, and a chip row of filters: Skill (All, Cutting, Joining, Finishing), Time per week, and Budget

Vertical timeline with a center spine and alternating left/right milestone cards — each card has week number badge, project name, what-you'll-learn bullet list (3 items), tools introduced, estimated hours, kit price, and an 'Add kit' button
Inline 'Checkpoint' blocks between weeks 4, 8, and 12 — each shows a skills-recap list, a downloadable practice sheet link, and a 'You're ready for…' next-step pointer
Bottom CTA panel offering a 'Buy the full path bundle' option with bundle price, savings amount, monthly-shipment toggle, and primary purchase button

pages.name: kit
pages.description: Detail page for a single beginner kit with timeline-based step preview
components: Same top bar
Two-column hero — left has a main project photo with a thumbnail strip below, right has kit name, week-number tag, price, duration estimate, skill meter, quantity stepper, and an 'Add to cart' button
What's in the box panel listed as a grid of parts (image, part name, quantity) plus a separate tools-included vs tools-needed two-column checklist
Build timeline strip showing the project as numbered steps along a horizontal bar — each step has a duration label, a one-line task, and a hover hint icon for the technique it teaches
Reviews section with average star rating, count, a 'first project ever?' filter toggle, and a list of review cards each showing reviewer name, weeks-into-path badge, rating, date, and review body

pages.name: workshop
pages.description: Free workshop and technique library organized by when you encounter each skill
components: Same top bar
Page header 'Workshop' with subtitle 'Techniques in the order you'll meet them' and a search input for techniques
Stepped timeline list grouped by week — each group has a week heading and below it a row of technique cards (icon, technique name, 2-minute read label, related-kit link)
Side rail (right) 'Tool glossary' with an alphabetical list of beginner tools — each row has tool icon, tool name, and a 'first used in week X' tag
Bottom safety panel with three icon-led blocks (Eye protection, Sharp edges, Dust) and a 'Print the safety checklist' link

pages.name: cart
pages.description: Cart page showing selected kits with a delivery schedule timeline
components: Same top bar
Page heading 'Your cart' with item-count subtext and a 'Subscribe and ship weekly' toggle that switches between one-time purchase and a paced shipment plan
Line-item list — each row shows project thumbnail, kit name, week-number tag, quantity stepper, line price, and a remove control
Delivery timeline card showing a horizontal bar of upcoming ship dates when the weekly toggle is on — each date marker shows kit name and an editable 'skip week' control
Order summary panel with subtotal, shipping, estimated tax, total, promo code input, accepted-payment icons, and a primary 'Checkout' button

pages.name: checkout
components: Slim top bar with just the shop name centered and a lock icon with 'Secure checkout' text on the right
Three-step progress indicator across the top: Contact, Shipping, Payment — with the current step highlighted
Two-column body — left stacks Contact, Shipping address, Shipping method radio cards (Standard, Rush, Pickup), and Payment form; right is a sticky order summary with totals and a 'Place order' button
Footer row with help link, refund-policy link, and a workshop-address line
